issues.problem: give-te-forms rule said the beneficiary of てあげる takes に; applied mechanically it yields 友達に手伝ってあげた, which the guide's own mistakes section marks wrong.
issues.action: Rule rewritten: doer of てくれる が, doer of てもらう に, てあげる keeps the verb's own particles.

issues.problem: Intro claimed the te-form favour verbs keep the same particles, contradicting the 手伝う/連れて行く を point.
give-ageru explain: 'cannot point at me or at my family from an outsider's point of view' was confusing.
issues.action: Reworded: あげる cannot be used when the gift comes to me or my family from someone outside.

issues.problem: give-kureru explain illustrated the plain くれる frame with a te-form example (親切にしてくれる), which belongs to give-te-forms.
issues.action: Replaced with 田中さんはいつもお菓子をくれる.
